format: html

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    name = "Median household\nincome"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016–2020 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_001",
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
edu_state |>
  filter(variable %in% c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025")) |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    percent_bachelors = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors), y = percent_bachelors)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher",
    subtitle = "Percentage by state-level geography",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016–2020 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_wide <- age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

largest_counties <- age_ca_wide |>
  slice_max(population, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    label_x = population * 0.8,
    label_y = c(44, 41, 38, 35, 32),
    county = str_remove(NAME, " County, California")
  )

ggplot(age_ca_wide, aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_segment(
    data = largest_counties,
    aes(x = population, y = median_age, xend = label_x, yend = label_y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = largest_counties,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = county),
    hjust = 1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.3))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Age vs. Population in California Counties",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016–2020 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
